data.name: My Little Empire: Cyber Lounge
data.detailed_description:
My Little Empire: Cyber Lounge is a top-down building and management simulator where you create and grow your own PC club in a lively city.

After a failed business, heavy debts, and a fresh start in a new city, you decide to rebuild your life from the ground up. This time, every decision matters. Start small, learn from past mistakes, and turn a modest cyber lounge into your own little empire.

Build and customize your PC club

Design the layout of your lounge, place computers, furniture, decorations, service areas, and upgrades. Create a space that attracts customers, keeps them comfortable, and helps your business grow.

Manage your business

Buy equipment, control expenses, improve your services, hire workers, and balance your income. A better club brings better customers, but growth also means more responsibility.

A living city around your business

Your cyber lounge is not isolated. Interact with other businesses, build relationships, find opportunities, and become part of the local economy.

Customers and staff

Serve different types of visitors, manage your workers, improve efficiency, and keep the club running smoothly. The better your service, the stronger your reputation becomes.

Grow from survival to success

You are not just building a room full of computers. You are rebuilding your life, reputation, and future. Expand carefully, make smart choices, and create a business you can be proud of.

Key Features:

- Build and decorate your own PC club

- Buy and upgrade computers, furniture, and equipment

- Manage money, staff, customers, and reputation

- Develop relationships with other businesses in the city

- Grow from a small lounge into a successful cyber empire

- Relaxed top-down management gameplay with a personal story

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requirements may change during development.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended.
